content: After seeing the magical conductivity of amethyst on your Ashen wand, you tinkered around more with them.
You managed to make a container that could hold magical energy when channeled through the amethyst.
Since the Arcane Vessel reacts to magical energy, it should be able to turn into the perfect catalyst for the Attunement Ritual you've been working on.
You're certain that you'll find more uses for this container.
